biotools.summary: DecXpert is a computer-aided detection (CAD) software developed to assist in the radiological diagnosis of tuberculosis from chest X-rays, particularly useful in resource-constrained settings. A recent study validated its performance with promising results, demonstrating potential to improve early detection and management of TB.
